What's new in DuckOS 1.0.67

• Passkeys: DuckOS is the phone's passkey provider. When a site in DuckWeb or any app offers “sign in with a passkey”, DuckOS makes one and keeps it on this phone and in DuckCloud with your passwords — and signs you in with your fingerprint or face. Settings › Passwords › Passkeys lists them.
• DuckOS Passwords is also the phone's autofill and credential provider from the first start.
